title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First-Day Rental Fee
content:
**Counter system reference — the first-day rental fee of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

## Rule

The first-day rental fee of a truck contract is posted when the contract opens at its pickup, as one base rental fee line dated that day with a quantity of one. The renter sees the first-day fee among the charges on the contract.

## What the posting does

`post_first_day_rental_fee_f35b099c` adds one base rental fee line for the amount given to the contract, dated the day of the call with a quantity of one, and the amount owed on the contract rises by that amount.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number the fee is posted on, read from the truck rental lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the renter on that contract, read from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The first-day rental fee in USD | Positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "posted", `truck_charge_id` (the id of the new fee line), `truck_rental_id`, `charge_type` "base_rental_fee", `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the day the line is posted) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the contract, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "posted" means the fee line is on the contract.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Called with an `amount` of 24.95, the tool returns `status` "posted", a new `truck_charge_id`, `charge_type` "base_rental_fee" and a `balance_due` 24.95 higher than before; the contract now shows one base rental fee line of 24.95 with a quantity of one, dated that day.
